body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself. Until your next turn, the first enemy that moves adjacent to you becomes Exposed.

surges.html: Enemies that become Exposed from this Action cannot make Reactions caused solely by your movement this turn.
When an enemy becomes Exposed from this Action, learn whether it has any unused Reactions or maintained effects.

rider.title: EVASION CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: You are targeted by an Action. Effect: Gain +1 Defense against that Action, then this Contingency ends.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
